description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyLogParser class, which parses monkey log files to extract ANR (Application Not Responding) events and integrates them into bug reports.

classes.name: MonkeyLogParser
classes.description: A parser class for processing monkey log files to identify ANR events and update bug reports accordingly.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a monkey log file, detects ANRs, and updates the provided bug report with the first detected ANR.

methods.name: extractAnrLines
methods.description: Extracts lines related to ANRs from the monkey log, marking the start and end of ANR sections.
